rationale: The interpreter output contains unresolved ambiguities regarding units, validation ranges, source data, and circuit addition/removal behavior. Each ambiguity must be clarified before the implementation can be considered complete.

findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the units to be used for circuit heights (e.g., inches, centimeters).

findings.description: Valid height ranges and precision are unspecified.
findings.action: Clarify the acceptable range of circuit heights and the required precision (number of decimal places).
